name: Claims
tagline: Finds money you are already owed in state registries, settlements and rebates
description: It works through the pools people forget: unclaimed-property registries in every state you have lived in, federal funds, class-action settlements and rebate programs. Anything it turns up comes with step-by-step guidance on filing and collecting. The searching is automated; the filing stays with you.
